# Aesthetic Nursing Policy & Procedures, Inc.

> Nurse-led med spa compliance consulting, state-specific aesthetic nursing policy and procedure manuals, standardized procedures and continuing education from Cindi Vokey, BSN, RN, LNC (San Diego, CA; serving practices across the United States). CA BRN-Approved CE Provider #18009. Manuals are educational practice resources to be reviewed and approved with the practice's medical director; they are not State Board approved and are not legal advice.

## Services
- [Services](https://aestheticnursingpnp.com/services/): Compliance Readiness Audit, Compliance Partner, custom state-specific manuals, Licensing & Probation Support, RN-to-Owner Accelerator
- [RN-to-Owner Accelerator](https://aestheticnursingpnp.com/accelerator/): 12-week program for RNs, NPs and PAs moving into practice ownership (cohort $4,500, private $6,500)
- [Manual Builder](https://aestheticnursingpnp.com/manual-builder/): State-specific med spa policy and procedure manual builder (open now; order online at https://theaestheticmanual.com, from $1,950)
- [Book a Free Consultation](https://aestheticnursingpnp.com/contact/): Free 30-minute consult

## Free Resources
- [Med Spa Compliance Readiness Checklist](https://aestheticnursingpnp.com/compliance-checklist/): 28-checkpoint self-audit
- [Binder Blueprint](https://aestheticnursingpnp.com/blueprint/): Free policy binder planner by state and treatment menu
- [The Accusation Review](https://aestheticnursingpnp.com/research/): Findings from 32 aesthetic licensing Board accusations
